editorial:
Imagine having your whole life look perfect on the outside while everything is actually falling apart behind the scenes. That is exactly what you get with Tina. She is on top of the world with a great business and a loving partner named Russell, but a shady accountant turns her dream into a nightmare. You will feel for her as she realizes her money and fame are slipping away right when she is about to win a huge award. The vibe is light and funny, but it also makes you think about what truly matters when the bank account hits zero.

You will love the chemistry between the characters, especially the tension when Tina goes back to her rich ex, Jacoby. The pacing keeps you interested, though some parts feel a bit predictable. If you enjoy stories about love triangles and big life lessons, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: In the end, Tina realizes that money cannot buy the kind of loyalty and peace she has with Russell. After trying to use Jacoby's wealth to fix her problems, she decides to let go of the greed. She chooses love over the paycheck and settles things with her business. The movie wraps up with Tina finding a balance between her career and her heart, finally choosing Russell as her true partner for the long haul.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a lesson about money.
